page.overview:
What is Noor al-Basri?

Noor al-Basri is a Banu Haqim of the Preservationist Assamites. He served as ambassador under Tegyrius in Singapore.

In 2024, the Assamite trio Gir, Pa and Ti ambushed a meeting between Noor and Hugo Eames, an attaché to Fatima al-Faqadi. Under the cover of an ongoing riot, the trio filled the Dragon Star Restaurant in which the meeting was occurring in the Singapore Chinatown with methane gas, then ignited it in order to destroy the two dignitaries. When the two grievously-wounded Banu Haqim were escorted out of the wreckage by their security detail, the trio began to take direct action, harrying the escort throughout their trek across the city to Eames' private plane.
